# Video Conference Model

## Purpose
The Video Conference Model provides entities for managing video servers, users, and rooms for online meetings.

## Key Entities
- **VideoServer**: Represents a video conferencing server (e.g., Jitsi).
- **VideoServerUser**: A user account on a video server.
- **Room**: A virtual meeting room.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- VideoServer
    Baseclass <|-- VideoServerUser
    Baseclass <|-- Room
    Baseclass <|-- RoomToVideoServerUser

    Room "many" -- "1" VideoServer
    VideoServerUser "many" -- "1" VideoServer
    RoomToVideoServerUser "many" -- "1" Room
    RoomToVideoServerUser "many" -- "1" VideoServerUser

    class VideoServer {
        +String name
        +String url
    }
    class VideoServerUser {
        +String username
        +VideoServer videoServer
    }
    class Room {
        +String name
        +VideoServer videoServer
    }
```
